messages:
Marta (Partnerships): Draft runbook uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/marketplace/runbook-v1 — quick read pls. Main asks: press embargo timing, partner logos/approvals, SI demo schedule, landing page handoff.
Lee (Marketing): reading now. Quick Q — do we have an embargo window from partners? Need dates for press outreach.
Sam (BD): NVIDIA wants a 48h heads-up, Azure marketplace wants listing doc by next Monday. HPE channel partner needs logo approval.
Ashok (Product): SI integration demo looks good; can provide a 10-min recorded demo by Friday. Who owns walkthrough script?
Viv (Eng): Can we freeze staging endpoint by Wed EOD? Need to lift prod feature flag Monday 9am PT.
Marta (Partnerships): Good notes. Proposed timeline (rough):
```
T-14 days: partner legal & logos due
T-7: marketing assets + press embargo sent to partners
T-3: landing page + docs staged
Day 0: announce across channels (blog, press, twitter, marketplace)
```
Lee (Marketing): I'll take press outreach + blog draft. Sam — please get logos to marketing drive by Tue.
Sam (BD): On it. Also need joint quote from NVIDIA — looping in their comms team today.
Ashok (Product): I'll own the SI demo script. Viv, can you review for accuracy by Thu?
Viv (Eng): Yep, can review Thu AM. Also adding a smoke test to deployment pipeline:
```
./deploy --env=staging --smoke
```
deploy-bot: release candidate created for staging by @Viv — rc-1991
press-bot: embargo email template draft posted in #marketing
Lee (Marketing): We need a single canonical landing URL. Suggest https://staging.redwood.com/marketplace/partners-launch — will switch to production on day 0.
Marta (Partnerships): Can partnerships get final landing copy by Thu EOD? Also need to confirm partner approvals matrix — I'll attach a checklist in the runbook.
Ashok (Product): Recorded demo will be uploaded to the shared drive; will include 3 use cases + architecture diagram.
Sam (BD): NVIDIA gave greenlight on quote, will paste in the runbook shortly.
Lee (Marketing): Timeline + owners: I'm drafting a spreadsheet. Will share before EOD for sign-offs.
Marta (Partnerships): Meeting Thurs 2pm PT to lock final items. Agenda: logos, embargo list, landing URL, SI demo schedule, QA signoff. If you can't make it, leave notes on the runbook.
Viv (Eng): Adding post-launch rollback playbook to runbook.
Sam (BD): Noted. Also confirm whether marketplace listing requires compliance docs from Legal — pinging legal.
Lee (Marketing): :thumbsup: thanks all — will send calendar invite.
Marta (Partnerships): Thanks — seeing good progress. Closing loop: last call for any blockers?
Ashok (Product): None from product side.
Viv (Eng): No blockers.
press-bot: embargo emails queued for partners once marketing confirms send time.
Marta (Partnerships): Great. Closing thread.
